title: OPEN ENROLLMENT (FOR THE UNDEAD)
about: A municipal office in a bunker audits a zombie for the Bronze Class health plan; it fails, the manager overrides the audit as Philosopher King, and the creature settles for a gray muffin while the assistant names justice a potluck.

beats.text: Muleshoe, Texas, after the end of the world. In a bunker under the Parks and Recreation office, the staff still hold meetings under fluorescent lights.
So, we've reached the point in the apocalypse where… we're doing benefits. For a zombie.
Strapped to an office chair with bungee cords is a Darkseeker, one of the undead. Today it applies for the Bronze Class health plan.
see: a man tied to a chair

beats.text: The Bronze Class health plan is not a handout. It is a privilege bestowed upon those who demonstrate baseline civic function. Also it includes dental. Which, frankly, they need.

Alright! Today is Open Enrollment. And as Regional Manager and Philosopher King, I want to say one thing: in this Republic, nobody is left behind. Unless Dwight says so. Which is most people. But not today.
To qualify, the candidate must not bite anyone for ninety seconds. Dwight sets a kitchen timer, writes its name down as Cletus, and begins the questions.
see: a man writing on a clipboard

beats.text: Dwight, remember: the Socratic method is about guiding someone to the truth. Not… intimidating them into compliance.
They are the same thing. Different fonts.
Do you want this stapler? So you desire it.
Oh! Desire! Great, great. We're starting with appetite.
Now. Is your desire for the stapler guided by reason… or by base appetite? That is not an answer. That is an urge. Reason is quiet. Urge sounds like a leaf blower.

beats.ask: you can't reason with something like that

beats.text: With thirty seconds left, the Darkseeker gets its teeth into the clipboard and tears off a corner of the forms. Dwight answers with pepper spray. Then the timer rings.
Time.
So… it qualified?
No. It bit the clipboard. Also it attempted to unionize my stapler.
I'm overriding.
You cannot override the Audit.
I can. I'm the Philosopher King.
Congratulations, Candidate Cletus. You are now Bronze Class. You get: one communal bandage per quarter, access to the gym treadmill bulb on Tuesdays, and vision coverage—
WE DO NOT HAVE VISION COVERAGE!
—of the Good.

beats.ask: and who is going to pay for all that

beats.text: The new member of Bronze Class goes quiet. Then it lunges, not for a neck, but for the tray of gray communal muffin cubes, and swallows one.
see: a tray of muffins on an office table

beats.text: It worked. Consensus.
No. That was not consensus. That was hunger settling for policy.
Great meeting! Next item: Potluck sign-up sheet.
The meeting started. The world ended. Justice is… apparently… a potluck.
Outside the bunker doors, the rest of the Darkseekers are knocking to get in.
see: fists banging on a heavy door
